summary: Diff adds a Valentine-themed single-page UI with Yes/No buttons, an evasive No button hook, and a success state that renders a local meme image. However, some acceptance criteria are not met (exact button label), the required static asset file is not evidenced as added, and several unrequested/authentication/backend-related features were introduced (Internet Identity + actor/backend).

missing_requirements.requirement: Two buttons are visible and labeled exactly "Yes" and "No".
missing_requirements.reason: The "Yes" button label includes extra characters ("Yes! 💕"), so it is not labeled exactly "Yes" as required.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add the generated meme image as a static asset under frontend/public/assets/generated with the exact filename valentine-good-choice-meme.dim_1200x1200.png.
missing_requirements.reason: The frontend references the image path, but the diff summary does not show the actual image file being added under frontend/public/assets/generated.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity authentication/provider and related identity management hooks.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly lists Internet Identity authentication as a non-goal, but the diff adds an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook and wires it into the app.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend canister actor scaffolding and frontend actor creation/querying logic.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requires a fully client-side experience with no backend canister logic, but a backend actor file is added and frontend code introduces actor creation (createActorWithConfig) and react-query wiring.

hallucinated_features.description: React Query client setup for fetching/caching actor state.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested for a single-page, no-backend Valentine prompt/meme experience; adds extra infrastructure beyond scope.
